ScopeItemStatement: Consequential work on generic runtime semantics uses a Root-owned standing scope carrier and declared runtime write locus; preserves the authority, security, residency, exclusion, and implementation-gate boundaries ruled by D-GOV-20; produces versioned-contract, affected-client conformance or migration, and proportionate regression evidence; returns release disposition to an accountable human; and does not transfer generic runtime ownership to App, PEC, or another client.
Notes: Standing carrier activated one bounded runtime-change tranche at a time. D-GOV-20 remains the ruled architectural basis; D-T0-23 is a coordinating Tier-0 counterpart, not a Root scope source. O-11 is in effect through D-GOV-28. SCA-004 preserves DEL-02-06 as the standing integration/release-assurance carrier and allocates bounded implementation and conformance slices to DEL-02-07 through DEL-02-12; REQ-027 and all ten held bindings remain unchanged. Runtime responsibility partition only; shared governance aspects map independently to GOV controls; AUTHORITY_AMENDMENT.md transfers locus, not security or release gates.
